images.alt: Farmhouse interior before the floor revision, with a masonry-looking floor.
Farmhouse interior after the revision, with honey-coloured wooden floorboards.
A blue sedan driving across the deck of the Golden Gate Bridge scene, with traffic ahead and a tower in the distance.
Cream masonry house with a charcoal gabled roof, olive shutters and a timber porch.
Red timber barn with white door bracing, a grey roof and an open side shelter.
Open timber wind pump with a metal rotor, tail vane and four braced legs.
Pale masonry mill house with a gabled roof and an exposed timber waterwheel.
Two timber rails between pointed posts, with a two-metre post-centre span.
Two matching timber fence runs joined at a right-angle corner post.
Braced timber gate with visible hinges and a three-metre usable opening.
Orange open-seat tractor with rear wheel guards, treaded tyres and a front grille.
Four-wheel timber farm trailer with low side boards and a drawbar.
Upright wooden barrel with a closed stave lid and three dark metal hoops.
Rectangular golden hay bale held by two parallel twine bands.
Farmer in blue overalls and a brimmed hat, carrying a three-prong pitchfork.
Brown-and-cream cow with small horns, a pink muzzle and dark hooves.
Sheep with a faceted white fleece, dark face and four dark legs.
White hen with a red comb, yellow legs and raised tail feathers.
Small cabbage seedling emerging from a low, faceted soil patch.
Young cabbage with spreading pale-green leaves on a soil patch.
Open cabbage rosette with layered green leaves and an upright centre.
Mature pale-green cabbage head held by broad outer leaves.
Cluster of golden wheat stems with narrow leaves and upright seed heads.
Low pumpkin vine with green leaves and two faceted orange fruits.
Small deciduous tree with a branching brown trunk and a faceted green crown.
Group of low, pale faceted rocks with a larger central stone.
Golden Gate Bridge seen obliquely from above: both towers, the main cables and the suspended roadway on a neutral grey backdrop.

Golden Gate Bridge from near water level, looking up at the south tower and the roadway.
Golden Gate Bridge from the roadway, looking along the lanes toward the towers ahead.
Golden Gate Bridge from beside the top of the south tower, with the main cables and the roadway below.
Golden Gate Bridge in side elevation, the full span between both anchorages.
Generic five-door hatchback with a two-box roofline, a steep tailgate and taillight clusters at the rear corners. Its paint is a neutral near-white, so a scene can tint each instance.

Generic four-door sedan with a low beltline, a notch-back deck and a full-width rear light bar. Authored as the drivable car of the Golden Gate scene, so its rear stays clean for a chase camera; the paint is a neutral near-white for scene tinting.
Generic five-door SUV with a tall, square greenhouse, raised ground clearance, larger wheel arches and a steep liftgate. Its paint is a neutral near-white for scene tinting.
Generic crew-cab pickup truck with a short bed. Made for traffic seen from about 3 m to 1 km, it steps from a detailed cab down to a boxy silhouette across three tiers.
Generic class 6 cab-over box truck with dual rear wheels. The cab takes the paint tint; the cargo box has its own untinted near-white material.
Generic 40 ft low-floor transit bus with two doors on the right, a two-tone body (paint above, trim below), dual rear wheels and a roof equipment pod. No operator livery, text or numbers.
